bio: Charles Joseph Crist Jr. ( KRIST; born July 24, 1956) is an American attorney and politician who is the mayor-elect of St. Petersburg, Florida. He previously served as the 44th governor of Florida from 2007 to 2011 and as the U.S. representative for Florida's 13th congressional district from 2017 to 2022.
offices: Member of the State Senate of Florida (1993–1999)
